about: THE MATERIALS A ROOM IS MADE OF (the user, 2026-11-19: "墙壁，地板的style再给不同的素材（比如冰面，大理石，木质，石头等等）"; "区域的整体材质主题和风格的选择会影响内饰"): floors - each a tile drawn as a 16 x 16 SVG, put into pixels by the page (play.js playMaterialTiles); walls - each one of the four wall sets (sandstone, stone, marble, timber) washed with a colour. The model chooses among them for each room, and may make new ones (agent/playmade.py) - kept beside the world and used again.
